references.implementation: chemicals 1.5.2 (MIT) COSTALD, COSTALD_mixture_parameters, COSTALD_mixture_compressed; Riedel pseudo saturation pressure transcribed independently in the generator
references.experimental: CoolProp 7.2.0 HEOS reference equations of state (saturated, compressed and bubble-point liquid molar density)

declared_domain.mixing_rule: Hankinson-Thomson COSTALD mixing; when water and methanol exceed the trace fraction, ideal (Amagat) mixing of pure saturated volumes (ChemSep DIPPR 105/106 for water and methanol, pure COSTALD for the others; components without a pure liquid volume at T may total at most the trace fraction and are left out); COSTALD-Tait with the Hankinson-Thomson mixture parameters in both cases
declared_domain.pressure_rule: Tait correction only above the generalized Riedel pseudo saturation pressure; otherwise the saturated value is reported with pressure_corrected=false

qualification_policy.rule: refused (OutsideValidityDomain) when non-qualified components exceed the trace fraction in total; qualified for a single component above trace or when every component above trace is mixture-qualified; otherwise unassessed. Budgets apply to qualified points only; other points are retained as evidence for the restriction.

implementation.quantity: molar volume and pseudo saturation pressure
implementation.rationale: Same closed-form expressions in double precision; R differs from fluids.constants by 2e-12 relative

experimental.rationale: Hankinson-Thomson report about 0.4 % average deviation for pure saturated liquids and Thomson-Brobst-Hankinson about 1 % for compressed liquids below Tr 0.95; 2 % bounds single points
Near-critical band 0.90 < Tr <= 0.95 where the corresponding-states fit and the reference EOS both lose accuracy
